description: This file defines the UpgraderController class, which extends an abstract installer Vue controller, and manages the upgrade process screen in the OrangeHRM system's installer module. It contains the preRender method that sets up the upgrade component and updates the state container.

classes.name: UpgraderController
classes.description: Controller handling the upgrade process screen within the installation workflow of OrangeHRM. It prepares the upgrade component and sets the current screen in the state container.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Initializes the upgrade process component and updates the state container to indicate the current upgrade screen.
